SMALL Groups

Join a community that learns from Jesus to become like Jesus

Fill out this form to connect with a group
Fill out this form to become a leader or host

Who?

Our groups are for anyone eager to grow. We don’t divide by age, gender, or life stage because we believe the Body of Christ is strongest when its diverse members find unity in Jesus.

What?

A place to go deeper. We dig deeper into the Scripture passage preached the previous Sunday, deeper into authentic community, and above all, deeper into discipleship to Jesus.

When?

Groups gather on Monday through Thursday evenings. Some meet year-round, while others follow a seasonal rhythm with intentional periods of rest.

Where?

In homes and living rooms throughout Lynchburg and the surrounding areas.

Why?

WORSHIP

Romans 12:1
Worship is more than just singing praise to God on Sunday mornings; it is the offering of your entire self—body, mind, and soul—to God. A small group is a practical place where disciples of Jesus can make themselves available to God to be used for his glory.

TRANSFORMATION

Romans 12:2
Jesus didn’t just save you from death; he saved you so that you could live abundantly! In his life and teachings, he displayed for us the greatest way to live. With his twelve disciples, Jesus modeled a community that learned from him to become like him. Our groups strive to do the same. There, we pursue the radical transformation of our souls into Christlikeness—which has always been God’s design for humanity.

FELLOWSHIP

Romans 12:3-8
You were not created to live in isolation. If your deepest trust is in Jesus for your salvation, then the Spirit of God resides in you, who calls you to give yourself fully to the Body of Christ. Romans 12 reminds us that “we, though many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.” No matter what you think you have to offer, God is clear: you belong and have something to give. In a small group, we move from being spectators to indispensable family members.
